messages:
Connor O'Brien: Canary enablement for Hosted overload protection in *us-east* today. Planning to flip the feature flag for 2 models (llama-3.1-70b + mistral-large) at low % and watch for 60–90m before expanding. If you’re an owner for gateway/routing/runtime/obs please drop your “ready” + what you’re watching.

Checklist (please confirm):
- Flag + rollout: `overload_protection_enabled` per (region, model) -> start 5%, then 25%, then 100% if clean
- Gateway: correct HTTP mapping for shed errors (429/503), `Retry-After` present, error code consistent
- Routing: breaker store healthy, transitions visible, no flapping
- Runtime: bounded queue enabled, shed reasons plumbed, no OOM/kv thrash
- Metrics to watch (primary):
  - p95/p99 latency (overall + per model)
  - 429/503 rate + Redwood overload codes breakdown
  - breaker state transitions (open/half-open) + cooldown
  - queue depth + drop/shed rate (edge vs runtime)
  - control plane latency (routing eval)
  - GPU saturation signals (util + queue time)
- Paging: confirm alerts won’t page as “hard 5xx incident” when we’re shedding by design

Target flip: ~10:30 PT (17:30 UTC). Dashboard link? + any last-minute gotchas.

(reactions: :eyes: x6)

Sergio Costa: Dashboard is ready. Use: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/overload-protection/hosted-overload-canary (us-east filter preset is saved under “canary-us-east”). Panels to keep on screen:
1) Requests admitted vs shed (edge + runtime)
2) Breaker state timeline by (model)
3) 429/503 by route + `error_code`
4) p99 end-to-end latency + “routing_eval_ms”
5) Runtime queue depth + scheduler wait

(reactions: :thumbsup: x4)

Aisha Bello: Alerts: I pushed a temp mute on “hosted-5xx-rate-high” scoped to `error_class=overload_protected` in us-east for the canary window (so we don’t page on expected 429/503). Internal 5xx / timeouts still page. Please still watch SLO burn panel (“Hosted API - Latency SLO burn”) since overload protection can hide tail failures.

Rafael Mendes: SRE ready. Two notes:
- Rollback trigger: if we see breaker flapping (>6 transitions/10m per model) OR p99 > +20% for >15m OR >2% increase in non-overload 5xx/timeouts.
- Rollback action: set `overload_protection_enabled=false` for (us-east, model) via config service; *do not* toggle quotas/rate-limit knobs at same time unless we’re in active incident.

Also, please validate `Retry-After` values aren’t tiny (we saw 0–1s in staging causing retry storms). Target 5–15s depending on shed reason.

(reactions: :white_check_mark: x3)

Benji Okafor: Config/rollout primitives ready. Flag exists and is wired per region/model. I’ll do the flip and post the config diff here. Current default is OFF globally.

Mina Haddad: Routing ready. Breaker store is healthy in us-east. I’ll watch:
- `breaker_open_ratio` (should stay near 0 unless we hit real saturation)
- `breaker_cooldown_seconds` distribution
- routing eval p99 (we don’t want control plane to become bottleneck)

Amara Diallo: Gateway ready. I’ll be watching:
- 429/503 response mix vs baseline
- error payload shape (OpenAI-compat endpoints too)
- presence of `Retry-After` + `x-redwood-error-code`
If you want a quick manual check, I can curl the canary route once it’s on.

Vikram Singh: Runtime ready. Bounded queue is on behind the same flag. Watching:
- `runtime_queue_depth` p95 and max
- shed reason counts: `QUEUE_FULL`, `MEM_PRESSURE`, `BREAKER_OPEN`
- GPU mem + kv-cache pressure; if we see kv thrash we’ll clamp earlier.

Ethan Park: Control plane ready. One thing: please keep canary at 5% for at least 30m so we can see steady-state + any periodic jobs. We’ve got some hourly batch traffic that can create mini-spikes.

Allison Grant: Observability note: please avoid ad-hoc slicing by high-cardinality labels in Grafana (customer_id etc). The canary dashboard is safe. If you need a custom query, ping me first so we don’t melt Mimir during the rollout.

DeployBot: deploy started: `redwood-api-gateway` build #21903 -> us-east (canary)

Connor O'Brien: Thanks all. Plan:
- 10:25 PT: confirm deploy green + no baseline regressions
- 10:30 PT: Benji flips 5% for llama-3.1-70b + mistral-large in us-east only
- 11:00 PT: if clean, bump to 25%
- 12:00 PT: decision on 100% for those two models (still us-east only)

Everyone please stay around for first 45m after flip. If you see anything weird, reply in-thread with screenshots + the exact panel name/time range.

(reactions: :thumbsup: x5)

DeployBot: deploy finished: `redwood-api-gateway` build #21903 -> us-east (canary) status=SUCCESS

Benji Okafor: Flipping flag now.
Config change:
- region=us-east
- models=[llama-3.1-70b, mistral-large]
- `overload_protection_enabled=true`
- `canary_percent=5`
ETA propagation ~2–3 minutes.

(reactions: :eyes: x7)

Sergio Costa: I’m seeing shed panels start to populate (very low, <0.1% so far). Breaker state is closed for both models. p99 stable.

Amara Diallo: Quick spot-check from edge: getting expected behavior.
- Normal request: 200
- Forced saturation test (synthetic): 503 with JSON body including `code=OVERLOAD_SHED_GATEWAY` and `Retry-After: 10`.
Also confirmed OpenAI-compat endpoint returns the mapped error object.

Rafael Mendes: Watching flapping: transitions are 0 so far. Control plane latency unchanged. One small thing: `Retry-After` is consistently 10s right now. That’s ok; later we can tune per shed reason, but for canary it’s fine.

Aisha Bello: SLO burn: no change. Error budget charts show overload-protected errors separated correctly (not counting as internal failure). :pray:

Connor O'Brien: 30m check: any objections to 25% bump?

(reactions: :thumbsup: x6)

Benji Okafor: Bumping to 25% now. Same scope (us-east + those 2 models). Propagation in a couple mins.

Sergio Costa: Post-bump: shed rate rose slightly (expected) but still <0.5%. p99 is +3–5% but within noise. No increase in non-overload 5xx.

Vikram Singh: Runtime looks good. Queue depth max went up but stayed below bound. Shed reasons mostly `QUEUE_FULL` at edge; runtime shed minimal.

Mina Haddad: Routing fine. No breaker opens. One warning: capacity signal `gpu_queue_wait_ms` spikes correlate with the hourly batch Ethan mentioned. Still ok, but keep an eye at top-of-hour.

Connor O'Brien: 12:00 PT decision point: looks clean. I propose we stay at 25% through top-of-hour batch, then go 100% for these 2 models in us-east if still stable.

Rafael Mendes: +1. Let’s do that. If batch spike causes sustained >1% shed for >10m or p99 +20%, we pause.

Benji Okafor: Top-of-hour came and went; metrics still fine. Flipping to 100% for those two models in us-east now.

Aisha Bello: Confirmed: no paging noise, internal 5xx flat, latency burn fine. I’ll leave the temporary alert mute in place for another 2 hours just in case, then revert.

Connor O'Brien: Canary enablement complete for us-east (llama-3.1-70b + mistral-large) at 100%. Thanks everyone. Next step is 24h soak then we’ll schedule us-west + eu-central. Please file follow-ups if you saw anything worth tuning (Retry-After, per-reason behavior, etc).
